# STEP block assembly study data (extended annotations)

Task and state annotations added to human-teleoperated simulated block assembly sequences.

## Example input and output

This is a source-grounded illustration of the task shape, not a copied or verified dataset row.

**Input:** Operator action history and a numbered-block workspace image.

**Output / label:** A structure goal, such as Bridge, and remaining actions to complete it.

![Eight goal structures in the STEP simulated block assembly study](https://arxiv.org/html/2608.27225v1/Figures/goals.png)

*Author Figure 4 shows goal structures; it is not a downloaded dataset input row.*

[Open the author-provided sample or demo](https://arxiv.org/html/2608.27225v1)

**Example evidence:** [paper](https://arxiv.org/html/2608.27225v1)

## Intention in this dataset

The manually labeled final block structure represents the human operator task goal; simulated robot plans are assistance outputs rather than autonomous-agent intentions.

**Relevance:** `explicit` · **Origin:** `synthetic` · **Year:** 2026

**Domains:** human_robot_interaction, industrial_collaboration  
**Intention types:** task_goal, collaborative  
**Tasks:** goal_recognition, future_activity_prediction  
**Modalities:** rgb, text, object_state  
**Formats:** image, text, structured_annotation
